tools.name: tenders
tools.description: UK public sector tenders open for bids, or contract awards with the winning suppliers (Companies House number, email, phone), from Find a Tender and Contracts Finder. Filter by keyword, CPV code, region and value. Up to 100 notices from the last 30 days, refreshed daily. Costs $0.05 per call, paid i

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tenders · Public sink: tenders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tenders · Public sink: tenders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
